title: Flat polynomial coordinates adapted to an admissible Artinian subalgebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, $\Lambda$ a Noetherian $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], $q\subset\Lambda$ a prime, $n\ge1$, $L=\Lambda_q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $J=qL$, $B=L/J^n$, $\pi:L\to B$ the quotient map, and $E\subset B$ finite. There exist a $k$-subalgebra $A\subset B$, local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A$, admissible [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra] for $JB$, with $E\subset A$ and $\mathfrak m_A=A\cap JB$, an integer $m\ge0$, a $k$-algebra map $\varphi:k[y_1,\ldots,y_m]\to\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and a ring map $\psi:P=k[y]_{{\varphi}^{-1}(q)}\to L$ extending $\Lambda\to L$ composed with $\varphi$, such that $qL=\varphi^{-1}(q)L$ and $\psi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. There are elements $a_j\in A$ whose images in $B$ are $\pi(\varphi(y_j))$ and whose residue differentials $d\bar a_j$ span $\Omega_{F/k}$ over $F=A/\mathfrak m_A$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. No essentially smooth factorization is part of this conclusion.

lean.statement: theorem exists_popescu_flat_coordinates (k : Type u) (Λ : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ) (q : Ideal Λ) [q.IsPrime] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (E : Finset (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸ (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)) : ∃ (A : Subalgebra k (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸ (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)) (_ : IsLocalRing A), A.IsPopescuAdmissible ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n))) ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = Ideal.comap A.val.toRingHom ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n))) ∧ (∀ e ∈ E, e ∈ A) ∧ ∃ (m : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k →ₐ[k] Λ) (ψ : Localization.AtPrime (q.comap φ.toRingHom) →+* Localization.AtPrime q), ψ.comp (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap φ.toRingHom))) = (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q)).comp φ.toRingHom ∧ q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q)) = (q.comap φ.toRingHom).map ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q)).comp φ.toRingHom) ∧ ψ.Flat ∧ ∃ a : Fin m → A, (∀ j, (a j : Localization.AtPrime q ⧸ (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n) = Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n) (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q) (φ (MvPolynomial.X j)))) ∧ Submodule.span (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (Set.range (fun j ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.residue A (a j)))) = ⊤
